quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: MHI Delivers Three Replacement Steam Generators for EDF's (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Electricite de France (EDF): MHI completed delivery of three replacement steam generators (SGs), manufactured at its Kobe facility (completed January 2024) and granted a certificate of compliance with the French nuclear regulatory authority's standards at the end of February this year, for installation in Unit 2 of the Cruas Nuclear Power Plant (900 MWe PWR); EDF ordered them in 2019 from MHI and Onet Technologies. MHI has received orders for a total of 9 replacement SGs from EDF; the remaining 6 units are being manufactured at Kobe with delivery scheduled from 2028 onwards. MHI has delivered a cumulative 15 replacement SGs to EDF since 2005 (excluding these), more than 30 replacement SGs overseas (France, Belgium, the United States), and has received orders for more than 130 SGs in total including new installations and replacements in Japan. Each SG is approximately 21 meters tall and weighs around 330 tons.
quarterly_data.figure: 3 SGs delivered; 9 replacement SGs ordered by EDF; remaining 6 for delivery from 2028 onwards; more than 130 SGs ordered in total
